core_obligations: Points versus irreducible closed subsets: sobriety of the space of a decent stack makes the map sending a point to its closure a bijection onto the irreducible closed subsets (proof lines 10721-10723)
Irreducible closed subsets versus integral closed substacks: to a closed irreducible subset one associates the reduced induced closed substack on it, which exists uniquely (proof lines 10724-10729)

That substack is integral: it is decent because decency is preserved under representable morphisms, its inertia is quasi-compact as a base change of the inertia of the ambient stack, and it is reduced with irreducible space (proof lines 10730-10735)
proof_roadmap: decent ⇒ |X| 是 sober ⇒ 点与不可约闭子集一一对应（取闭包）。
给定闭不可约 T，取既约诱导闭子栈 Z（唯一，且 |Z| = T）。
Z decent（可表示态射保持 decency）、惯性准紧（I_X 的基变换）、既约、空间不可约 ⇒ Z 整 ⇒ 三条一一对应。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a decent algebraic stack with quasi-compact inertia there are canonical bijections between the points of the stack, the irreducible closed subsets of its space and the integral closed substacks (author lemma at source lines 10707-10719, label lemma-decent-irreducible-closed). The proof (source lines 10721-10736) obtains the first bijection from sobriety, associates to a closed irreducible subset the reduced induced closed substack and verifies that it is integral using decency, quasi-compactness of the inertia under base change, reducedness and irreducibility (proof lines 10721-10735). The three-way correspondence and the integrality check are the content. H3.
